content.caption:
Your bladder deals with a lot more than people realize, and cranberries actually help by preventing bacteria from sticking to the bladder wall, which is why they're linked to fewer infections. Your thyroid runs your whole metabolism quietly in the background, and brazil nuts are one of the richest natural sources of selenium, a mineral your thyroid needs to convert hormones into their active form. The spleen filters your blood and recycles old red blood cells, and pomegranate's antioxidants help protect those blood cells from oxidative damage while they're being processed. Everyone's body is different, listen to yours.
